text:
maria: Following up on the postmortem for the 03/18 capacity surge (INC-2026-03-18). I put a short owner/timeline list below — please ack and call out any missing items. I want us to have concrete owners by EOD today.

maria: ACTIONS:
- quota: request emergency quota bump + long-term quota request (owner: ajay, ETA: 2026-03-25)
- scheduler tuning: decrease preemption window, tune binpacking policy (owner: tom, ETA: 2026-03-22)
- headroom plan: define per-cluster headroom % and burst strategy (owner: sara, ETA: 2026-04-01)
- autoscale test harness: smoke tests for sudden traffic spikes (owner: devon, ETA: 2026-03-29)
- runbook updates: add surge triage checklist + SKUs to page (owner: maria, ETA: 2026-03-21)

ajay: Acked. I'll open the quota request today and add the PR/req links here. For long-term we'll need usage curves — can ops/data help?

sara: Ack. For headroom, can we pick an initial target? I propose 15% for prod clusters and 25% for p99 workloads until we have regression data.

maria: @sara that seems reasonable as a starting point. We'll treat it as conservative and revisit after two weeks of telemetry.

.tom: (typo) tom: +1 on scheduler changes. I want to try lowering the preemption window from 120s -> 30s and enable soft-affinity binpack. I'll post a canary config to eng-infra and run against staging load.

devon: For autoscale test harness I can wire up a replay of the spike from logs. ETA still ok. Need two GPUs on staging for 2h to run full sweep. Who can approve?

ajay: I'll submit the quota bump request to cloud-provider today and link the support ticket. For staging GPU time I'll escalate to infra budget owners — pinging @maria and @devon for exact times.

maria: I've added an inventory table to the postmortem doc with affected SKUs and regions: https://redwood.internal/postmortems/INC-2026-03-18. Please add any missing entries.

ops-bot: Reminder set: weekly check-in for "GPU capacity follow-ups" starting 2026-03-23 09:00 PT (recurrence: weekly). Assigned to: maria, ajay, tom.

.sara: Quick question — how do we track progress on the scheduler tuning? Can we add a short playbook with KPIs (p50/p95 token latency, infra cost delta, preemption rate)?

maria: Yes. I'll create a tracking sheet with those KPIs and add owners for each KPI. Will post link by EOD.

tom: One blocker: binpacking change might increase latency for small requests. I'll include a canary that measures tail latency and provide rollback if >5% reg.

devon: For the test harness I'll include an automated script (k8s job + load generator). Example command to run locally:

```
kubectl run spike-demo --image=redwood/loadgen:latest --restart=OnFailure --nodes=2 -- /bin/sh -c "python replay_spike.py --log sample_spike.json"
```

ajay: added ticket #CP-4321 for quota bump. Link: https://cloud.vendor/support/CP-4321. I'll drop PR for infra changes after tom posts canary config.

maria: Thanks all. Plan for next steps: 1) owners acknowledge (done) 2) tom posts canary config by 03/20 3) ajay gets quota bump in flight by 03/21 4) devon runs autoscale harness on staging by 03/25 5) weekly check-ins until all items green. If anything slips, escalate to eng-sre on call.

tom: I'll post the canary config in eng-infra and tag this thread. Expect to start canary 2026-03-20 08:00 PT.

ajay: Noted. I'll update the incident tracker and mark owner fields.

maria: Closing the loop here — thanks for the quick responses. I'll send calendar invites for the weekly sync. :thumbsup:
